turns.text: Me and three friends are doing a food crawl downtown and we can only fit in one dinner stop. Which?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to describe all the options before I hear your opinion.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A tiny taco stand with only stools outside, cash only, but the reviews are ridiculous.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A new Korean fried chicken spot that just opened, apparently the lines are long on Fridays.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A classic old diner that's been there for fifty years, famous for its pie.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a fancy small plates bar where everything costs about twelve dollars a plate.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So, that's all of them. Tell me what you think.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: On a food crawl you want something quick and memorable, so the taco stand is a strong pick, just bring cash. The Korean chicken is great for sharing if the line isn't too bad. I'd save the diner for the dessert leg, that pie sounds like a finale.
